note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

/sign-in.reason: cinatra#2356 (epic #2353, PR #2405): the v0.7.0 connectors spec re-specifies the CONNECTED status mark as a joined plug — literally the two halves of the Disconnected `Unplug` glyph with the gap closed — and lucide draws no such icon (`PlugZap` is a half plug plus a lightning bolt; `Plug` is a different drawing). It is therefore ONE net-new first-party leaf module, packages/sdk-ui/src/icons.tsx, reached through the PRE-EXISTING @cinatra-ai/sdk-ui edge every locked route already carries. Keeping it off the locked routes was weighed and costs something real in every form: the spec requires the SAME drawing at four render sites spanning two packages plus the host app, so a per-package copy would violate the single-definition requirement the epic decided on (and would let the four sites drift apart, which is the exact defect the swap exists to fix); folding the glyph into an already-counted sdk-ui module would hold the count flat but give up the isolated leaf seam — the glyph's own render suite (icons.test.tsx) would have to drive it through an unrelated component — and would put an icon registry inside a component file; and a lazy dynamic import was rejected outright as trading static analyzability for a green check. The module is deliberately kept OFF the sdk-ui root and /marketplace barrels (the ./tabs precedent, locked in the suite), so the growth is one leaf, not a barrel. One shared single-definition module, one extra edge, +1 on every locked route. Supersedes this route's #2401 record (1667 -> 1668, the provider-neutral batch-v2 normalization module on the pre-existing @cinatra-ai/llm barrel edge), which this raise retires.
